title: TSL (R<=2) separable regression on california_housing: test RMSE

split.decision: Paper: OpenML CTR-23 california_housing (20640 rows) split 80/20 with sklearn train_test_split(random_state=0) -> train 16512 / test 4128; the paper has no val. Bench: the 4128 test rows (verified identical to the reproduction's archived test arrays) are the judge's test split; from the 16512 paper-train rows, 20% are carved out as val with train_test_split(random_state=20261029) -> train 13209 / val 3303. ids = 0-based row numbers of the OpenML table; all files sorted by id.

baseline.paper_ref: paper Table 1 (p.8) california_housing, TSL (R<=2): 54557.89 test RMSE (single 80/20 split, authors' tuned refit on all 16512 train rows, seed 42); reproduction with code v0.3.0 + released best trial: 54138.595 (same 16512 rows). Bench reference trains on 13209 rows (val carved out) with seeds 1,2,3, so it is not directly comparable.

allowed_changes: Training algorithm, surrogate loss, optimizer and arbitrary univariate factors including neural functions may change within the same four-product capacity class.
Two-stage TSL, ordered signs, positive factors and step-function parameterization are baseline constructions rather than the scientific rank budget.

When retaining the supplied TSL pipeline, changing only n_trees=200, n_iter=64, split_try=10, min_interval_samples=56 or the other released `best_params` values in `code/configs/california_housing_tsl_r2.json` does not count as a method improvement.
fixed_contract: Improve raw-USD house-value RMSE within the paper-supported low-separation-rank interpretable regression class.
The predictor is a sum of at most four rank-one products of univariate functions of the eight original raw features; a nonzero standalone constant consumes one term.
Original target units/censoring, supplied fixed train/validation/test splits, pointwise raw-feature factor access, reconstruction tolerance<1e-6 and RMSE remain fixed.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Do not replace the four-product separable model with a generic neural/tree predictor, add a fifth term/unaccounted intercept, or let one factor inspect multiple raw coordinates or row identity.
No external/held-out data, changed raw features/target units or dishonest structure/reconstruction cards.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.
Copies of this data from an installed package count as external data (patch audit).
